LanguageData.SEC_Research_Standard_Packaging.label: Standard Packaging
LanguageData.SEC_Research_Standard_Packaging.descript: Learn how to pack goods according to Alfau standard.
LanguageData.SEC_Research_Classic_Alfaus.label: Classic Alfaus
LanguageData.SEC_Research_Classic_Alfaus.description: Learn about the traditional culture of Alfau and how to make historical Alfaus' artifacts.
LanguageData.SEC_Research_Alfau_Literature.label: Alfau Literature
LanguageData.SEC_Research_Alfau_Literature.descriptio: Transform Alfau literatures into forms that can be read by the people living in the rimworld to spread the culture and ideology of Alfau, and provide more entertainment options for colonizers.
LanguageData.SEC_Research_Alfau_Architecture.label: Alfau Architecture
LanguageData.SEC_Research_Alfau_Architecture.descript: Learn about the architecture of Alfau and how to construct classic Alfaus' structures.
LanguageData.SEC_Research_Standard_Template_Processor: Attention: This project can only be researched by cloned secretaries.\n\nTo improve the investment efficiency and expansion speed of interstellar colonization, Secretary Nexus stored a large number of principles, blueprints, and production processes of tools, machines, and weapons that are suitable for various resource conditions and production environments in every secretaries' artificial brain and every spacecraft computer. These production guides known as 'standard templates' are the cornerstone of the prosperity and development of all Alfaus clans in their new home. The standard template processor is a tool used for transforming standard template into forms that common people who lack scientific principle foundation can understand, it usually downloads standard template data from secretaries' artificial brain, Alfaus orbiting satellites and spacecrafts, and base stations built by Secretary Nexus, after processing, it outputs to the user in the form of blueprints, step instructions, etc.
LanguageData.SEC_Research_Standard_Alfau_Weaponry.des: Download standard Alfau weapon component blueprints and other data required for manufacturing standard Alfau weapons from Secretary Nexus. Most standard Alfau weapons can be assembled using standard Alfau components, and by understanding the principles of them, a skilled craftsman can also use more basic materials to make standard Alfau weapons when standard Alfau components are lacking.
LanguageData.SEC_Research_Standard_Laser_Weaponry.des: Obtain standard laser weaponry production license. As an interstellar race, Alfaus' expertise in energy weapons is unique. Compared to ballistic weapons, energy weapons save more space and have lower ammunition costs, so they were quickly adopted as the standard self-defense weaponry for interstellar colonies.
LanguageData.SEC_Research_Standard_Heavy_Weaponry.des: Obtain standard heavy weaponry production license. On the journey of interstellar colonization, secretaries have faced countless targets difficult to destroy, like hostile alien civilizations and dangerous wildlife and plants. Fortunately, Alfaus are not unfamiliar with the tools of war.\n\nPerhaps it is also a kind of misfortune.
LanguageData.SEC_Research_Standard_Towed_Weaponry.des: Obtain standard towed weaponry production license. From Revolutionary War to the stars, solid and reliable heavy weapons have made great contributions. When Alfaus are limited by local production conditions and unable to manufacture mechanized equipment, they don't mind bringing these ancient, powerful, but difficult to move weapons back to the battlefield.
LanguageData.SEC_Research_Standard_Ballistic_Weaponry: Obtain standard ballistic weaponry production license. Although Alfaus' laser weaponry is the best on their home planet, but the need to develop remote planets prevented them from falling behind in ballistic weapons. Instead, their ballistic weaponry is renowned for reliable and multipurpose designs. As the saying goes, Alfaus' Alfau rifles are at Alfaus' place, Alfau rifles without Alfaus are at your place.
Apply to participate in the coil weapon experiment, these experiments are not top secret and those weapons have been tested for a while. Due to communication difficulties, some weapons have already been finalized and mass-produced but rarely known in rimworld.
LanguageData.SEC_Research_Standard_Coil_Weaponry.desc: Obtain standard coil weaponry production license. The personal coil weapon is Alfaus' next generation standard equipment, with contact with other interstellar civilizations, Alfaus face enemies wearing powered armor more and more frequently, traditional personal weapons are becoming increasingly inadequate. But their achievements in energy weapons quickly led them to find a new solution, the coil weaponry. Currently, the coil weapons are very rare in rimworld, only a small number of units are equipped with them and pose a significant threat to armored targets.
LanguageData.SEC_Research_Alfau_Industry.label: Alfau Industry
LanguageData.SEC_Research_Alfau_Industry.description: Download the Alfau industrial equipment blueprints from Secretary Nexus. These industrial equipment were designed specifically for colonies to reduce their dependence on imported goods and achieve self-sufficiency as soon as possible. Their design intentionally avoids the use of high-tech and high-precision components.
LanguageData.SEC_Research_Alfau_Metallurgy.label: Alfau Metallurgy
LanguageData.SEC_Research_Alfau_Metallurgy.descriptio: Download the Alfau metallurgical formulas and other metallurgical knowledge required from Secretary Nexus to smelt advanced alloy materials.
LanguageData.SEC_Research_Standard_Power_Cell.label: Standard Power Cell
LanguageData.SEC_Research_Standard_Power_Cell.descrip: Obtain standard power cell production license. Power cells with large capacity, high efficiency, and fast discharge speed are the foundation for manufacturing energy weaponry like personal laser weapons.
LanguageData.SEC_Research_Small_Size_Power_Engine.des: Obtain small size power engine production license. Power cell is not a simple battery, if you want it to output energy in the expected way, you need to use specific machines. Power engine is the collective term for machines that use power cells to output mechanical energy.
LanguageData.SEC_Research_Secretary_Nexus_Node.label: Secretary Nexus Node (Unfinished)
LanguageData.SEC_Research_Secretary_Nexus_Node.descri:
Obtain Secretary Nexus infrastructures construction permit. A well functioning Secretary Nexus server is the foundation of Alfaus' interstellar colonization, is the only way to quickly decrypt and use Secretary Nexus standard templates. Although all the knowledge and blueprints required for most production and living situations are stored in secretary's artificial brain, but if you lack suitable equipment, these data packs cannot be fully decrypted and cannot fully realize their intended value.

Attention: Only secretaries know how to build a SECN server. By the way, you need a potato to build one, do not ask why, the standard template says so. And there is a tip says server will shut down immediately if someone takes this potato away.

(Unfinished)
LanguageData.SEC_Research_Secretary_Nexus_Client.desc:
解锁书姬网络客户端建造许可。你可以用它聊天、看视频、查资料、托管机器、检查生产、建立监视网络、指挥自动炮台，你甚至可以用它访问书姬网络。

请注意：只有书姬们知道如何建造一台书姬网络客户端。

LanguageData.SEC_Research_Secretary_Cloning_Engineeri: Obtain Secretary cloning engineering infrastructures construction permit. Secretary cloning technology and network technology originated from a large prehistoric civilization ruin beneath the Alfau Peninsula. Discovered by the Alfaus in the early industrial era, the ruin contained machines are still in good condition, Alfaus used them to produce the first secretaries. For a considerable period thereafter, due to incomplete understanding of the technologies, as well as ethical and safety concerns, these technologies were used only to produce and further improve secretary clones, and production scale remained limited. By the interstellar era, to meet the governance needs of vast territories and the expanding interstellar colonization efforts, the Secretary Nexus developed a set of clone production equipment that was easy to transport and install, enabling the on‑site production of secretary clones in alien environments while reducing logistics and administrative costs.
LanguageData.SEC_Research_Standard_Gears.label: Standard Personal Gears
LanguageData.SEC_Research_Standard_Gears.description: Obtain standard personal gears production license. Behold the standard clothing style that secretaries have got tired of wearing in the past centuries! After the gears being distributed, some decorations not so standard often appear on those standard gears, that is how secretaries distinguish each other and show their individuality.
LanguageData.SEC_Research_Standard_Exoskeleton.label: Standard Exoskeleton
LanguageData.SEC_Research_Standard_Exoskeleton.descri: Obtain standard exoskeleton production license. These multipurpose equipment have been time-tested on the journey of interstellar colonization, and countless variants of it have been created. Just like other standard equipment, unauthorized modifications often appear after being distributed, and some of them even surpass the modifications on other equipment in terms of variety because of the built-in power source of exoskeleton.
LanguageData.SEC_Research_Alfau_Biomimetic_Muscle.des: Obtain Alfau biomimetic muscle production license. Alfau's achievements in biology have greatly advanced their research on biomimetics, and quickly reached a leading level among countries on their home planet in the fields with urgent needs, such as industrial and military equipment. Due to cost and material limitations, traditional mechanical structures still hold a place in new-born colonies, but it's very hard now to find a Alfaus settlements with more advanced production equipment that don't use biomimetic equipment.
